reasoning: This workflow implements an AI-powered customer support triage system for FairTix, a fair ticket marketplace. When new support messages arrive via Google Sheets, the workflow uses Claude AI to classify them into predefined categories (FAQ, Account/Verification, Payment/Billing, Technical/Bug, Resale/Transfer, Feedback) and determine sentiment. For FAQ-type questions, it automatically generates responses using a knowledge base from Google Docs. For complex issues requiring human intervention, it notifies the support team via email. The system maintains a complete audit trail in Google Sheets with classifications, confidence scores, and AI-generated responses.
name: FairTix AI Support Triage System
businessNarrative: This workflow transforms FairTix's customer support from reactive to intelligent, automatically triaging and responding to customer inquiries. It reduces support team workload by handling FAQ responses autonomously while ensuring complex issues get proper human attention. The sophisticated AI classification system with confidence scoring reveals the company's commitment to data-driven support operations and scalable customer service. This automation enables FairTix to maintain responsive customer support as they grow their marketplace business without proportionally scaling their support headcount.
trigger: New support message added to Google Sheets
dataFlow: Support messages from Google Sheets → AI classification with sentiment analysis → FAQ responses generated from knowledge base → Results stored back to sheets + email notifications for manual review cases
